statusDetail: 58/58 atomic checks recorded and judged across four representative paths.

page.framework: Mixed server-rendered, React-like listing, Next.js product
page.notes: m.indiamart.com redirects to www.indiamart.com. Representative coverage includes home, listing, product/enquiry entry, and 404 recovery. Authenticated account, payment, seller administration, and final lead submission were not covered because they require credentials or would create a real commercial enquiry.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark-mode emulation leaves the light page and white consent surface unchanged.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reduced-motion probe matched reduce and reported zero active animations.
Lighthouse reports failing foreground/background contrast and the contrast-emulated capture does not provide a robust alternate treatment.
DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations for route or state changes on this interaction-heavy marketplace.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-linked effects or animation-timeline, so there is no JS scroll-animation anti-pattern on tested paths.

The 17,968px landing page has static chrome and DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state or progress treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-positioned popover requiring anchored positioning was present on exercised paths.
The mobile listing is clipped and dense, with competing controls and no clear focus cue as users move from category to product.
A consent interstitial obscures nearly the full first viewport on home, listing, and product paths before interaction.
Four custom role=dialog surfaces are present, while no native dialog or popover elements are used.
Dense headers, category grids, promotional cards, and a full consent layer crowd the narrow viewport and obscure core content.
At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports 1007px scroll width and 647px horizontal overflow; product content renders at 876px.
DOM/CSS probe found zero container-query styles while reused marketplace components overflow narrow contexts.
Programmatically focused first control has outline:none, no box shadow, and a zero-size rect.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence

checkOutcomes.method: Direct DOM, screenshot, evaluate, discoverability, trace, Lighthouse, or heap evidence

paths.description: Marketplace landing page and category discovery; represents the entry experience.
Brick-making-machines category listing; represents search/category browsing and supplier comparison.
Brick Making Machine product detail and Contact Supplier entry; represents detail and lead-generation flow.
Unknown route; represents HTTP error recovery.

findings.summary: Dark-mode emulation leaves the light page and white consent surface unchanged.
findings.evidence: Dark-mode emulation leaves the light page and white consent surface unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme and preference-driven light/dark design tokens.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reports failing foreground/background contrast and the contrast-emulated capture does not provide a robust alternate treatment.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports failing foreground/background contrast and the contrast-emulated capture does not provide a robust alternate treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct failing color pairs and test controls under prefers-contrast and forced-colors.

findings.summary: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations for route or state changes on this interaction-heavy marketplace.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations for route or state changes on this interaction-heavy marketplace.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for navigations that currently swap abruptly.

findings.summary: The 17,968px landing page has static chrome and DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state or progress treatment.
findings.evidence: The 17,968px landing page has static chrome and DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-aware header or progress affordance where it helps long-page orientation.

findings.summary: The mobile listing is clipped and dense, with competing controls and no clear focus cue as users move from category to product.
findings.evidence: The mobile listing is clipped and dense, with competing controls and no clear focus cue as users move from category to product.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a clear selected state, focus management, and directional transition/highlight after navigation.

findings.summary: A consent interstitial obscures nearly the full first viewport on home, listing, and product paths before interaction.
findings.evidence: A consent interstitial obscures nearly the full first viewport on home, listing, and product paths before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface where legally possible and preserve an immediate, equally prominent decline path.

findings.summary: Four custom role=dialog surfaces are present, while no native dialog or popover elements are used.
findings.evidence: Four custom role=dialog surfaces are present, while no native dialog or popover elements are used.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog/popover semantics, modal focus containment, and declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Dense headers, category grids, promotional cards, and a full consent layer crowd the narrow viewport and obscure core content.
findings.evidence: Dense headers, category grids, promotional cards, and a full consent layer crowd the narrow viewport and obscure core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce promotional chrome and prioritize category/product content and primary actions.

findings.summary: At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports 1007px scroll width and 647px horizontal overflow; product content renders at 876px.
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports 1007px scroll width and 647px horizontal overflow; product content renders at 876px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed desktop widths, use intrinsic sizing and fluid layouts, and validate all representative templates at 320-360px.

findings.summary: DOM/CSS probe found zero container-query styles while reused marketplace components overflow narrow contexts.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probe found zero container-query styles while reused marketplace components overflow narrow contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable cards, headers, and dialogs container-responsive instead of relying on desktop widths.

findings.summary: Programmatically focused first control has outline:none, no box shadow, and a zero-size rect.
findings.evidence: Programmatically focused first control has outline:none, no box shadow, and a zero-size rect.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible :focus-visible states and audit touch-target sizing and hover fallbacks.

findings.summary: The Contact Supplier journey is preceded by a 211-partner consent flow; after confirming choices the synthetic primary-action replay exposed no lead dialog, adding uncertainty and detour.
findings.evidence: The Contact Supplier journey is preceded by a 211-partner consent flow; after confirming choices the synthetic primary-action replay exposed no lead dialog, adding uncertainty and detour.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep consent separate from the supplier enquiry and make the lead form open predictably with a short, clearly staged flow.

findings.summary: Mobile layout observation measured CLS 0.169; all 91 homepage images lack width/height and 90 below-fold images are not lazy loaded.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout observation measured CLS 0.169; all 91 homepage images lack width/height and 90 below-fold images are not lazy loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space with dimensions/aspect-ratio and stabilize late banners and consent UI.

findings.summary: HAR records 167 requests and 3.59MB transferred, including 2.04MB images and 1.16MB scripts; Lighthouse flags dependency and LCP discovery issues.
findings.evidence: HAR records 167 requests and 3.59MB transferred, including 2.04MB images and 1.16MB scripts; Lighthouse flags dependency and LCP discovery issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, prioritize the LCP resource, defer non-critical images/scripts, and set effective caching.

findings.summary: Lighthouse estimates 187KiB unused JavaScript and 20KiB unused CSS, alongside 18 script requests.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 187KiB unused JavaScript and 20KiB unused CSS, alongside 18 script requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and defer or remove unused and third-party code.

findings.summary: Lighthouse finds links without discernible names; image audit finds missing alt, and visible lead inputs lack associated labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds links without discernible names; image audit finds missing alt, and visible lead inputs lack associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control an accessible name, label form inputs, and supply meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Lighthouse accessibility audit fails color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility audit fails color contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Update text and essential UI colors to meet WCAG contrast minimums in every state.

findings.summary: Lighthouse finds no main landmark and malformed lists; focus probe shows no visible outline.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds no main landmark and malformed lists; focus probe shows no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add logical landmarks/headings/lists and persistent keyboard focus indicators with sensible focus order.

findings.summary: At 360px, headings and dialog copy are clipped offscreen and overlap because the visual layout remains hundreds of pixels wider than the viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360px, headings and dialog copy are clipped offscreen and overlap because the visual layout remains hundreds of pixels wider than the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow text to the visual viewport, constrain line lengths, and prevent clipping/overlap.

findings.summary: A 360px visual viewport renders 876-1007px layouts, so reflow fails and core content/dialog controls are partly offscreen.
findings.evidence: A 360px visual viewport renders 876-1007px layouts, so reflow fails and core content/dialog controls are partly offscreen.
findings.suggestedFix: Support 320 CSS px and 400% zoom without two-dimensional scrolling; retain user scaling and adequate targets.

findings.summary: Although doctype and UTF-8 are valid, Lighthouse finds incorrect image aspect ratios and the image audit reports 91 images without dimensions.
findings.evidence: Although doctype and UTF-8 are valid, Lighthouse finds incorrect image aspect ratios and the image audit reports 91 images without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve intrinsic aspect ratios and declare image dimensions while keeping the valid document metadata.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable BFCache blockers and confirm no stale listeners or unload handlers prevent restoration.

findings.summary: Pages return 200 and canonical metadata exists, but https://www.indiamart.com/sitemap.xml returns 404 and robots contains extensive crawler-specific policy.
findings.evidence: Pages return 200 and canonical metadata exists, but https://www.indiamart.com/sitemap.xml returns 404 and robots contains extensive crawler-specific policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish/declare valid sitemap indexes and keep canonical, robots, and crawler policy consistent across hosts.

findings.summary: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff are present, but CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; all nine observed cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None, including sessid.
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff are present, but CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; all nine observed cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None, including sessid.
findings.suggestedFix: Harden CSP with nonces/hashes and set Secure, suitable SameSite, and HttpOnly on session/auth cookies.

findings.summary: Tracker probe sees 23 third-party origins, five known tracker domains, and consent describes sharing with 211 partners including precise geolocation.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe sees 23 third-party origins, five known tracker domains, and consent describes sharing with 211 partners including precise geolocation.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors and data purposes, gate non-essential requests until consent, and batch essential analytics.

findings.summary: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; CSP is permissive, although HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing are present.
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; CSP is permissive, although HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and progressively tighten CSP/Trusted Types.

findings.summary: Consent dialogs and product content are cut off at narrow viewport edges, so overlays do not reposition/reflow robustly.
findings.evidence: Consent dialogs and product content are cut off at narrow viewport edges, so overlays do not reposition/reflow robustly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use viewport-safe native modal layout and intrinsic sizing with overflow containment.

findings.summary: The initial consent layer offers Consent and Manage options, not an equally direct reject action, while describing 211 partners and precise geolocation.
findings.evidence: The initial consent layer offers Consent and Manage options, not an equally direct reject action, while describing 211 partners and precise geolocation.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer Reject all beside Accept/Consent with equal prominence and minimize default purposes/vendors.

findings.summary: Visible enquiry inputs have required=false and aria-invalid absent; no clear inline validation contract is exposed.
findings.evidence: Visible enquiry inputs have required=false and aria-invalid absent; no clear inline validation contract is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required semantics, validate after interaction, and announce actionable inline errors.

findings.summary: Lead email/name inputs expose empty autocomplete values and mostly placeholder-only identification.
findings.evidence: Lead email/name inputs expose empty autocomplete values and mostly placeholder-only identification.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct email/name/tel autocomplete tokens and persistent labels.

findings.summary: The core supplier-contact flow is mixed with an extensive consent decision and the CTA replay did not expose a clear staged enquiry state.
findings.evidence: The core supplier-contact flow is mixed with an extensive consent decision and the CTA replay did not expose a clear staged enquiry state.
findings.suggestedFix: Decouple consent from enquiry, show what data is shared and with whom, and make cancel/back paths explicit.

findings.summary: Of 91 homepage images, 90 are legacy JPG/PNG, 90 below-fold images are not lazy, and responsive srcset coverage is sparse.
findings.evidence: Of 91 homepage images, 90 are legacy JPG/PNG, 90 below-fold images are not lazy, and responsive srcset coverage is sparse.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, dimensions, and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: The landing page issues 167 requests and ships 18 scripts even though Lighthouse estimates substantial unused code.
findings.evidence: The landing page issues 167 requests and ships 18 scripts even though Lighthouse estimates substantial unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background/non-essential fetching and remove unused work by route and consent state.

findings.summary: The load transfers 3.59MB across 24 origins; 23 are classified third-party relative to the requested m. host and five are known trackers.
findings.evidence: The load transfers 3.59MB across 24 origins; 23 are classified third-party relative to the requested m. host and five are known trackers.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template byte/request budgets and load advertising/analytics only after need and consent.

findings.summary: Commerce content is server-visible, but DOM inspection finds no WebMCP/agentic tool registration for structured product discovery or supplier enquiries.
findings.evidence: Commerce content is server-visible, but DOM inspection finds no WebMCP/agentic tool registration for structured product discovery or supplier enquiries.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe, permissioned product-search and enquiry tools through emerging agent-capability patterns.

findings.summary: Baseline product heap contains 565,337 nodes and 32.9MB self size; the post-interaction capture reaches 590,285 nodes and 35.6MB for a single product view.
findings.evidence: Baseline product heap contains 565,337 nodes and 32.9MB self size; the post-interaction capture reaches 590,285 nodes and 35.6MB for a single product view.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile retained trees and reduce long-lived product, ad, and consent objects; set a representative memory budget.
